thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected on /v1/generate (prompt-preproc). p99 latency = 4.92s (SLO 4.0s), p95 = 1.12s. Streaming tail stalls observed for ~30% of sessions. Paging oncall.

marta: got the page, joining now. @sunil can you take lead on runtime side? I’ll triage preproc. @alex can you look at routing/traffic shaping?

sunil: on it. first quick question — is this across all regions or localized?

ingrid: seeing it from us-east-1 and eu-west-1. spike started ~3166999945 (about 55s before alert). throughput hasn't changed much.

marta: customer impact: several PLG customers seeing slow streaming. cs pinged — one enterprise (org_id: 8347) reported client-side timeouts at ~28-35s.

alex: temporarily rolling routing policy to prefer dedicated-pool-2 for routes /generate and /chat while we dig. will push in 30s.

sunil: logs from preproc workers show long template hydration for JSON mode. sample:
```
2026-03-15T12:00:14Z preproc-12 ERROR template_hydrate: took 2.8s for template_id=tpl-json-43 path=/v1/generate
stack: prompt_builder::hydrate -> tool_schema::expand -> tokenizer::tokenize_json
```

sunil: looks like tokenization + tool schema expansion for JSON-mode requests is dominated by repeated schema validation and canonicalization.

marta: mitigation checklist: 1) route new traffic away from preproc pool 2) increase preproc worker concurrency 3) disable JSON-mode parsing for non-enterprise tenants 4) add short-circuit cache for template->tokens mapping

ingrid: increasing preproc workers in cluster lead to higher CPU spikes; might just move to draining workers and restart with updated env flags to disable heavy validations.

alex: routing change applied: ~40% of traffic moved to dedicated-pool-2, 20% fallback to older quantized model (still compatible). Observing immediate drop in tail stalls for streaming sessions routed out of pool.

marta: @sunil can you push a hotfix: skip tool-schema canonicalize when request includes header X-skip-schema=true ? We can add proxy to inject header for non-enterprise tenants.

sunil: prepping patch. deploy plan: build small binary, deploy to preproc staging, then canary 10% in prod on preproc-ensemble. Command I'm running:
```
rdctl preproc deploy --binary preproc:v1.14-hotfix --canary 0.1 --selector pool=prompt-processor
```

emma: CS update — enterprise 8347 switched to retry backoff client side; still high failure rate but fewer timed-out sessions. They're asking for ETA.

marta: ETA for initial mitigation (routing + canary) ~8-12 min. full disable-canonicalize rollout depends on canary health.

sunil: canary started: saw first canary worker pick up requests at 3167000020. Instrumentation shows per-request template_hydrate dropped from median 850ms -> 120ms for canary requests.

ingrid: p99 latency for /v1/generate across global now 3.1s (was 4.92s). streaming tail stall rate dropped from 30% -> 8% for canary paths.

oncall-pager: paging followup — have we assessed potential data correctness risk when skipping canonicalize? need product signoff for schema skipping.

marta: short-term: only skip canonicalize for non-enterprise tenants and routes marked as 'best-effort-streaming'. We'll capture raw input and run offline validator to compare outputs for a sample of requests.

alex: adding temporary rate-limit on large payloads (len(prompt_tokens) > 4096) at the edge to reduce worst-case CPU work. Policy in edge-config pushed.

sunil: canary 5m report: error rate not increased, latency improved. Rolling to 50%.

ingrid: monitoring dashboard snippets:
- p95 global: 1.2s -> 0.9s
- p99 global: 4.92s -> 2.8s
- streaming tail stalls: 30% -> 6%
- preproc CPU avg: +12% during restarts

marta: good. Customer impact summary for incident record: ~12 customers had >2% degradation, 1 enterprise had repeated client-side timeouts. No data loss. Root cause preliminary: repeated expensive tokenization + tool-schema canonicalization in JSON-mode prompt templates leading to pathological tail CPU and serialization delays.

sunil: creating mitigation follow-ups:
- short-term: skip canonicalize for non-enterprise, cache hydrated-token blobs keyed by (template_id, schema_hash) — owner: sunil
- mid-term: refactor tokenizer path to incremental tokenizer for JSON-mode — owner: alex
- infra: add autoscaling headroom for preproc when median template_hydrate > 500ms — owner: ingrid

marta: handoff to next oncall (sam) at 3167001200. I'll create incident ticket in jira: RINF-INC-2026-314 and assign owners.

emma: CS notify sent to affected customers with advisory and ETA. enterprise 8347 flagged for SRE follow-up.

sunil: note: we observed a small regression in legacy path due to cache eviction; patching now. Will update in thread.

alex: small snippet we used at edge to inject header for route-based bypass:
```
if request.tenant_tier != 'enterprise':
  request.headers['X-skip-schema'] = 'true'
```

marta: agreed we should add an automated eval (postmortem) that compares outputs between full-schema and skip-schema for 10k historical requests to verify no correctness regression. add to postmortem.

ingrid: one more note: streaming stalls were amplified by client libraries that expect continuous chunking; when template_hydrate delayed first chunk, client timed out. Recommend client-side retry guidance in SDK.

sunil: patch deployed to all preproc nodes at 3167000335. Monitoring now shows stable p99 ~2.2s. Will keep an eye for 30m then close incident.

marta: thanks team. please add any residual todos to RINF-INC-2026-314 board. I'll follow up with postmortem template and link to evals.

ingrid: adding tagging: "root_cause: tokenizer-json-canonicalize", "mitigation: schema-bypass-canary", "customer_impact: streaming_tail_timeouts" to incident doc.

emma: thx. CS will reach out to enterprise 8347 with root-cause summary once postmortem is ready.

oncall-pager: acknowledged handoff to sam. all major mitigations applied. leaving page open until p99 stable <3s for 30m.

marta: closing real-time triage — moving to postmortem tracking. :thumbsup:
